_comment: Per-workload object-type apply toggles for Users. Loaded automatically by Restore-M365TenantConfig when scope.workloadSwitches.Users = true and restore.config.json does not contain an inline scope.workloadObjectTypes.Users block. Schema: flat { name: bool } or wrapped { objectTypes: { name: bool } }. Users restore is export-first today: none of these flags drive write-back yet; they list what we have on disk so admins can pre-select scope as apply coverage grows.
